verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the API, which lets you fetch inquiry statuses and verification details, plus webhooks that stream event data to your own service. A user could assemble their own export from these, but that is a do-it-yourself workaround, not a documented export feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account data export, an explicit statement of open export formats, account-deletion or offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
